fees.notes: Legacy file name; maps to the official Diploma in Computer Science. International student tuition: RM32,800 total. Source: https://www.uniten.edu.my/programme/diploma/diploma-in-computer-science/ (UNITEN official programme page, accessed 2026-09-18). Confirmed by UNITEN International Undergraduate Fee Structure (Dec 2024). per_year = total / 2.5yr nominal duration.

requirements.other_qualifications: Pass SPM/O-Level with minimum 3 credits (Grade C) including Mathematics; or UEC with minimum Grade B6 in 4 subjects including Advanced Mathematics; or STAM with minimum MAQBUL and Mathematics SPM (Grade C); or STPM with minimum Grade C (CGPA 2.00) in one subject and Mathematics SPM (Grade C); or Certificate Level 3 (MQF) in a related field with minimum CGPA 2.00.
